query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marvel_cards WHERE set_id = (SELECT id FROM marvel_sets WHERE name LIKE '%Chrome%' AND name NOT LIKE '%Sapphire%' AND name NOT LIKE '%Studios%' LIMIT 1)) as total_chrome,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marvel_cards WHERE set_id = (SELECT id FROM marvel_sets WHERE name LIKE '%Chrome%' AND name NOT LIKE '%Sapphire%' AND name NOT LIKE '%Studios%' LIMIT 1) AND image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url != '') as chrome_with_images,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marvel_cards WHERE set_id = (SELECT id FROM marvel_sets WHERE name LIKE '%Comic Book%' LIMIT 1)) as total_cbh,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marvel_cards WHERE set_id = (SELECT id FROM marvel_sets WHERE name LIKE '%Comic Book%' LIMIT 1) AND image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url != '') as cbh_with_images;
